promptMarker: Use the imagegen skill to create a production game home-field bitmap.

terrain_grass_base_01.subject: one production-quality 2D top-down grass tile cell for a reusable dark forest RPG meadow tileset
terrain_grass_base_01.details: Simple production terrain tile in the cute dark storybook hub style: broad muted green ground, soft flat mossy shadows, only 3-6 tiny hand-drawn grass strokes or yellow-green flecks. Most of the tile must remain open walkable space. Do not make a realistic texture painting, clover field, or detailed wallpaper. Edges must be calm and compatible so it repeats without visible boxes.
terrain_grass_base_01.constraints: no characters, no props, no mushrooms, no path, no horizon, no vignette, no text, no UI overlays, no dense detailed grass texture, no obvious center highlight, no photoreal detail. Must read as simple walkable ground first.

terrain_grass_base_02.subject: one production-quality 2D top-down grass variation tile for a reusable dark forest RPG meadow tileset
terrain_grass_base_02.details: Second simple grass tile that sits beside grass_base_01. Use the same broad muted green field, slightly different soft moss shadow patches, and only a few sparse dark grass strokes. Keep it flatter and calmer than a painted RPG texture. No readable plant clusters; object-layer props provide foliage personality.
terrain_grass_base_02.constraints: no characters, no props, no mushrooms, no path, no horizon, no vignette, no text, no dense micro-detail, no clover field, no unique center feature. Must tile calmly with grass_base_01.

terrain_grass_flowers_01.subject: one sparse accent 2D tilemap grass cell with tiny clover and spore flowers
terrain_grass_flowers_01.details: Sparse simple accent terrain tile: same broad muted green ground as the base tiles, with 2-4 tiny simple flower/sprout marks and a few short hand-drawn grass strokes. The accent must feel like a small hand-placed detail, not a flower field. Most of the tile remains empty walkable ground.
terrain_grass_flowers_01.constraints: no characters, no props, no large flowers, no clover carpet, no horizon, no vignette, no text, no dense scatter, no repeated dot field. Flowers must not extend beyond the tile boundary.

terrain_path_dirt_straight.subject: one reusable 2D tilemap cell: horizontal packed-earth path connector
terrain_path_dirt_straight.details: Simple connector tile: a broad soft dirt path crosses west-to-east through the middle third of the tile, with muted green grass above and below. Path shape is hand-drawn and slightly wavy, with 2-4 small simple stroke marks. Flat storybook colors, not realistic soil texture. West/east edges must expose the same path width and Y position.
terrain_path_dirt_straight.constraints: no characters, no props, no signs, no horizon, no vignette, no text, no dense pebble texture, no realistic dirt. Path must align horizontally for tiling.

terrain_path_spore_glow.subject: one reusable 2D tilemap cell: horizontal packed-earth path connector with soft amber guide glow
terrain_path_spore_glow.details: Simple connector variant of path_dirt_straight. Same broad west-to-east path band and compatible grass margins. Add a very restrained warm amber mycelium guide line or tiny dots along the path center, like a graphic storybook hint, not a detailed glowing texture.
terrain_path_spore_glow.constraints: no props, no signs, no horizon, no text, no spotlight, no dense glowing particles, no destination marker. Path edges must align with path_dirt_straight for tiling.

terrain_path_destination_row.subject: one reusable 2D tilemap cell: isolated grass-compatible destination landing tile
terrain_path_destination_row.details: Simple isolated top destination landing tile for the current proof map. Use a broad flat dirt or moss landing patch blended into muted green grass on all four edges. It sits under/near entrance props but contains no arch, gate, sign, or text. Keep it reusable as a single landing accent, not a horizontal path connector row.
terrain_path_destination_row.constraints: no Arena arch, no Journey gate, no signs, no props, no horizon, no text, no full-scene lighting, no unique focal symbol. All four edges must be grass-compatible.

terrain_edge_roots_01.subject: one seamless 2D tilemap terrain cell of dense root growth marking the edge of the walkable field
terrain_edge_roots_01.details: Simple blocked-edge terrain tile: muted dark green ground with a few chunky hand-drawn root or vine strokes along the blocked side/outer feeling. It should be graphic and readable, not a dense root texture or lattice. Works as an edge tile when repeated.
terrain_edge_roots_01.constraints: no characters, no signposts, no full forest scene, no horizon, no text, no detailed root web, no schematic red lines. Must read clearly as a blocked edge, not as a path.

terrain_edge_moss_rocks_01.subject: one seamless 2D tilemap terrain cell of mossy rocks and forest debris marking a blocked field edge
terrain_edge_moss_rocks_01.details: Simple blocked-edge terrain tile: muted dark green ground with a few broad mossy rock/debris shapes and short grass strokes. Keep shapes chunky and low-count, like object silhouettes baked into a simple edge tile, not a noisy texture.
terrain_edge_moss_rocks_01.constraints: no characters, no signposts, no full forest scene, no horizon, no text, no many repeated circles. Same readability as edge_roots_01.

prop_bush_cluster_dark_01.subject: transparent-background 2D top-down forest prop: dark organic bush mass for a game hub object layer
prop_bush_cluster_dark_01.details: A soft painterly dark-green bush that reads as one continuous natural shrub mass, not a pile of separate round crowns. Use an asymmetric footprint, uneven scalloped outer edge, and only 2-4 large overlapping foliage masses. Each mass should be broad and simple, like a soft painted blob with a few edge cuts, not a cluster of many small leafy segments. Use subtle shadow pockets and small negative notches so the silhouette feels hand-shaped and natural. Keep internal texture extremely simple: broad value shapes only, no individual leaf clusters. It must be recognizable at 48-64px on a mobile field screenshot.
prop_bush_cluster_dark_01.constraints: Centered, bottom-anchored. No grass tile background, no text, no characters, no mushrooms. Avoid broccoli/cauliflower blobs, flower rosettes, evenly spaced circular clumps, repeated stamp marks, many tiny leaves, many small rounded segments, or a mound made from many same-size mini bushes.

prop_bush_cluster_light_01.subject: transparent-background 2D top-down forest prop: lighter organic bush mass for a game hub object layer
prop_bush_cluster_light_01.details: A lighter moss-green companion to bush_cluster_dark_01, but still quiet enough for the mobile field. It should feel like one irregular natural shrub with only 2-4 large blended lobes, uneven leafy edge, offset highlights, and broad simple value shapes. Use darker, cooler moss greens with restrained yellow-green highlights; avoid a bright lemon/yellow mound that steals focus from chibis. Keep the form low, broad, asymmetric, and hand-painted, with a compact transparent shadow. The bush should be made from a few big readable masses, not many small segments. It should layer over quiet terrain without looking like repeated circular stamps, and it must remain readable at 48-64px.
prop_bush_cluster_light_01.constraints: Centered, bottom-anchored. No grass tile background, no text, no characters, no mushrooms. Avoid broccoli/cauliflower blobs, flower rosettes, evenly spaced circular clumps, repeated stamp marks, tiny texture noise, many small leafy segments, bright yellow/lemon dominance, or an obvious procedural mound.

prop_leaf_sprout_01.subject: transparent-background 2D top-down forest prop: small leafy sprout cluster
prop_leaf_sprout_01.details: A small readable sprout like the simple leaf clusters in the liked reference: 3-5 broad leaves, muted moss green, soft painterly shading, transparent background, and a faint compact shadow. Use bold leaf shapes and minimal veins so it reads beside chibi feet at mobile scale.
prop_leaf_sprout_01.constraints: Small centered sprout with bottom-center anchor. No tile background, no flowers field, no text, no characters, no over-detailed botanical rendering, no tiny leaf texture.

prop_mutant_broccoli_bush_01.subject: transparent-background 2D game prop: intentionally funny mutated broccoli bush
prop_mutant_broccoli_bush_01.details: A cute weird vegetable-foliage prop that clearly references a little broccoli crown while still belonging to the dark storybook mushroom meadow. Make it intentional and entertaining with a bold asymmetric crown, one chunky twisted stem base, dark warm outline, compact blob shadow, and at most one simple mutated accent. It must read as a joke prop at 48-64px, not as an accidental normal bush.
prop_mutant_broccoli_bush_01.constraints: Object-layer prop only. No terrain background, no text, no characters, no photoreal vegetable, no grocery-store broccoli photo, no tiny speckles, no many small florets. Keep silhouette readable and cute at mobile scale.

prop_cabbage_rose_bush_01.subject: transparent-background 2D game prop: strange cabbage rose bush
prop_cabbage_rose_bush_01.details: A playful hybrid of cabbage and rose: 4-6 broad cabbage-like leafy cup shapes arranged like one oversized dark fairytale flower bush. Use muted moss, teal, and yellow-green leaves with simple violet shadow pockets. The silhouette should be chunky, asymmetrical, and recognizable at 48-64px, with a compact transparent shadow.
prop_cabbage_rose_bush_01.constraints: Object-layer prop only. No normal flower bouquet, no realistic cabbage, no terrain tile, no text, no characters, no dense leaf veins. Must feel intentional and cohesive with the Home Field style.

prop_carrot_sprout_cluster_01.subject: transparent-background 2D game prop: funny carrot sprout cluster
prop_carrot_sprout_cluster_01.details: A small cluster of 3 squat carrot tops poking from the moss like mischievous garden props. Orange roots are partly visible, with big leafy green tops exaggerated into cute-goth shapes. Use a warm dark outline, a compact shadow, and minimal dirt marks. Reads as a small walkable decorative accent at mobile scale.
prop_carrot_sprout_cluster_01.constraints: No full vegetable basket, no realistic carrots, no text, no characters, no terrain background, no tiny crumbs/noise. Keep it low and readable beside chibi feet.

prop_onion_flower_01.subject: transparent-background 2D game prop: odd onion flower
prop_onion_flower_01.details: A single weird onion-like bulb sprouting a whimsical flower stem. The bulb is squat and pale bone-green with purple shadow, the flower is simple and graphic, and the whole prop has a dark storybook outline. It should feel like a strange garden discovery rather than a normal botanical illustration.
prop_onion_flower_01.constraints: No photoreal onion, no text, no characters, no terrain background. Keep silhouette clear, friendly, and compact.

prop_turnip_mushroom_01.subject: transparent-background 2D game prop: turnip crossed with a mushroom
prop_turnip_mushroom_01.details: A funny root-vegetable mushroom hybrid: one round turnip body, two stubby root feet, and a simple mushroom-cap top. Use muted cream, moss green, violet shadows, and one small red or amber accent. Cute, odd, readable, and slightly magical at mobile scale.
prop_turnip_mushroom_01.constraints: No face unless extremely subtle and non-character-like, no text, no realistic vegetable rendering, no terrain background, no tiny tendrils. Must remain a prop, not a chibi character.

prop_tomato_eye_flower_01.subject: transparent-background 2D game prop: tiny strange tomato-eye flower
prop_tomato_eye_flower_01.details: A rare funny flower prop with a small red tomato-like bulb at the center that vaguely resembles a single occult eye, surrounded by simple leafy petals. Keep it cute and playful, not scary. Use the Home Field muted palette, dark warm outline, and compact blob shadow.
prop_tomato_eye_flower_01.constraints: No gore, no realistic eyeball, no horror, no text, no characters, no terrain background. It should read as a vegetable-flower joke at small size.

prop_pepper_pod_bush_01.subject: transparent-background 2D game prop: pepper pod bush with strange curled leaves
prop_pepper_pod_bush_01.details: A small dark leafy bush with 2-3 large dangling pepper-like pods in muted red, amber, and violet. Leaves curl in simple cute-goth shapes, with a chunky readable silhouette and compact shadow. It should feel like a decorative weird garden prop for field edges and still read at 48-64px.
prop_pepper_pod_bush_01.constraints: No realistic pepper plant, no repeated circular bush stamps, no text, no characters, no terrain background, no many tiny pods. Keep pods sparse and readable.

prop_beetroot_heart_plant_01.subject: transparent-background 2D game prop: beetroot heart plant
prop_beetroot_heart_plant_01.details: A cute odd beetroot-like plant where the root forms a subtle heart shape under dark leafy sprouts. Use muted beet red, moss green, violet shadows, and warm dark outline. It should be playful and affectionate without becoming a UI icon.
prop_beetroot_heart_plant_01.constraints: No literal heart symbol, no text, no characters, no photoreal beet, no terrain background. Keep it organic and field-safe.

prop_mushroom_cluster_small_amber.subject: transparent-background 2D game prop: small cluster of amber-glowing mushrooms
prop_mushroom_cluster_small_amber.details: A tiny field-token mushroom cluster designed to read inside a 52x52 mobile CSS box. Use 2-3 squat amber caps total, pale stems merged into one simple base, one bold outside silhouette, 2-3 main color regions, and at most 1-2 large highlight blobs. Cute-but-eerie dark fairytale mood. Lighting matches style anchor. Subtle compact blob shadow under the cluster.
prop_mushroom_cluster_small_amber.constraints: Centered cluster; anchor point at bottom-center (visual base). No characters, no text, no more than 3 caps, no tiny cap field, no gills, no dense speckles, no glossy hero-object rendering.

prop_mushroom_cluster_small_violet.subject: transparent-background 2D game prop: small cluster of violet bioluminescent mushrooms
prop_mushroom_cluster_small_violet.details: A tiny field-token mushroom cluster designed to read inside a 52x52 mobile CSS box. Similar chunky composition to amber cluster but with clearly violet caps, 2-3 caps total, a merged simple base, one bold outside silhouette, 2-3 main color regions, and at most 1-2 large muted violet glow accents. The cap color must still read violet at 32-48px on dark green grass, not gray or charcoal. Provides quiet color contrast across the field. Subtle compact blob shadow under the cluster.
prop_mushroom_cluster_small_violet.constraints: Centered cluster; anchor point at bottom-center. No characters, no text, no more than 3 caps, no tiny cap field, no gills, no dense speckles, no gray-only caps, no saturated neon glow.

prop_mushroom_cluster_tall_green.subject: transparent-background 2D game prop: tall cluster of green-capped mushrooms with thick stems
prop_mushroom_cluster_tall_green.details: 3-4 mushrooms standing 2x taller than they are wide, with exaggerated squat-cute caps and slightly eerie curved stems. Top half is mushroom caps; bottom half is stems and moss. Provides forest depth at field edges.
prop_mushroom_cluster_tall_green.constraints: Anchor point at bottom-center. Caps must read as taller than a chibi (mushrooms feel imposing).

prop_mushroom_cap_red_spotted.subject: transparent-background 2D game prop: a single red mushroom with white-spotted cap, the classic fairytale silhouette
prop_mushroom_cap_red_spotted.details: A small field-token red-and-white toadstool designed to read inside a 52x52 mobile CSS box. Use one chunky cap, one simple stem, 3-5 large cream spots, one dark outline, and broad flat color blocks. Familiar enough to be a landmark, but quiet enough to sit at the field edge without stealing focus from chibis.
prop_mushroom_cap_red_spotted.constraints: Centered, bottom-anchored. No characters, no text, no dense spot pattern, no visible gill forest, no bumpy stem texture, no glossy hero-object rendering.

prop_mycelium_lantern_amber.subject: transparent-background 2D game prop: an amber spore lantern shaped like a tall mushroom with a glowing cap
prop_mycelium_lantern_amber.details: A mushroom-shaped lantern with a warm amber candle glow inside the cap, casting a soft graphic halo. Used near the Arena entrance for lighting. Stem and base look hand-carved, organic, and slightly ritual-like without readable symbols.
prop_mycelium_lantern_amber.constraints: Anchor at bottom-center. Glow must read clearly.

prop_fallen_branch_mycelium.subject: transparent-background 2D game prop: a fallen branch wrapped in mycelium and small mushroom growth
prop_fallen_branch_mycelium.details: A low field-token obstacle designed to read inside a 52x52 mobile CSS box. Use one simple horizontal log silhouette, 2-3 bark color blocks, one chunky pale mycelium wrap, and maybe 1-2 tiny mushrooms at one end. Reads as 'walkable around, not through' without becoming a detailed root nest.
prop_fallen_branch_mycelium.constraints: Anchor at bottom-center of the branch. No root tangles, no many thin strands, no bark chips, no tiny mushroom colony, no realistic texture, no high-contrast clutter.

prop_signpost_blank.subject: transparent-background 2D game prop: an art-only wooden signpost made from organic carved mushroom wood
prop_signpost_blank.details: Tall signpost with a flat sign-board on top, shaped like carved mushroom wood in a cute dark storybook style. The board surface is intentionally BLANK (no text, no symbols) because runtime will render localized text overlay on top. Sign material has mycelium veins and chunky readable edges.
prop_signpost_blank.constraints: Anchor at bottom-center. CRITICAL: the sign-board MUST be blank — no readable text, no icons, no characters. Just the carved wood/mycelium surface.

exit_arena_mushroom_arch.subject: transparent-background 2D game entrance prop: an Arena entrance formed by two giant living mushrooms forming an arch
exit_arena_mushroom_arch.details: Two large mushroom trunks lean toward each other forming a doorway arch, with a bold cute-goth silhouette and carved organic ritual feel. Warm amber spore lanterns hang from the underside of the arch. Small battle banners (no text, just abstract fungal shapes) drape from the arch. Inside the arch a soft amber glow suggests a portal beyond. Roots and mycelium spread from the base.
exit_arena_mushroom_arch.constraints: Anchor at bottom-center (base of the arch). No characters inside the arch. No readable text on the banners. Reads as combat-ready and inviting.

exit_journey_gate_under_construction.subject: transparent-background 2D game entrance prop: a mossy path into a deeper mushroom forest, blocked by organic vine rope and small construction signs
exit_journey_gate_under_construction.details: Mushroom-wood gate posts on either side, avoiding realistic medieval stone. Organic vine rope strung between them, blocking entry. Small blank warning boards hang from the rope (art-only, no readable text). Behind the gate, the path continues into a darker, foggier forest. A dim violet lantern hangs at the side. Mood: cute, occult woodland, whimsical, not modern; clearly reads as 'not available yet'.
exit_journey_gate_under_construction.constraints: Anchor at bottom-center. No characters. Sign-boards must be art-only blank surfaces (no text).

effect_spore_motes_loop.subject: transparent-background 2D game effect frame: a single 256x256 frame of drifting amber spore motes for an ambient field overlay
effect_spore_motes_loop.details: PER-FRAME GENERATION: generate ONE 256x256 frame per imagegen call. Save each frame as .agent/home-field-workspace/raw/spore_motes_loop.frame_NN.source.png (NN = 00..07). Across the 8 frames the motes (4-6 small soft amber motes per frame) drift incrementally upward and fade in/out — a looping cycle. Motes should be simple graphic glowing dots, not realistic dust. The produce script composes them into a 2048x256 horizontal strip after all 8 are generated.
effect_spore_motes_loop.size: 256x256 per individual frame (NOT the composed strip)
effect_spore_motes_loop.transparency: transparent background required (alpha channel must be honored)
effect_spore_motes_loop.constraints: No solid background. Motes are diffuse, soft-edged. Each frame nudges the motes a little; frame 8 must connect cleanly to frame 1 (loop). Per-frame raw filename: spore_motes_loop.frame_NN.source.png.

effect_arena_portal_shimmer.subject: transparent-background 2D game effect frame: a single 512x512 frame of a warm amber portal shimmer for the Arena arch interior
effect_arena_portal_shimmer.details: PER-FRAME GENERATION: generate ONE 512x512 frame per imagegen call. Save each frame as .agent/home-field-workspace/raw/arena_portal_shimmer.frame_NN.source.png (NN = 00..07). Each frame shows a slightly different simple graphic distortion / wave pattern of amber light suggesting a magical portal. The produce script composes them into a 4096x512 horizontal strip after all 8 are generated.
effect_arena_portal_shimmer.size: 512x512 per individual frame (NOT the composed strip)
effect_arena_portal_shimmer.constraints: No solid background. No hard edges. Frame 8 loops cleanly to frame 1. Per-frame raw filename: arena_portal_shimmer.frame_NN.source.png.

effect_mycelium_path_pulse.subject: transparent-background 2D game effect frame: a single 256x256 frame of a bioluminescent pulse running along the path tile
effect_mycelium_path_pulse.details: PER-FRAME GENERATION: generate ONE 256x256 frame per imagegen call. Save each frame as .agent/home-field-workspace/raw/mycelium_path_pulse.frame_NN.source.png (NN = 00..07). Frame 0 shows a soft amber-violet pulse on the left edge; frame 7 shows it on the right edge; intermediate frames interpolate horizontally. The produce script composes them into a 2048x256 horizontal strip.
effect_mycelium_path_pulse.constraints: Pulse is soft, not a hard line. Loops cleanly. Per-frame raw filename: mycelium_path_pulse.frame_NN.source.png.

effect_journey_blocked_rustle.subject: transparent-background 2D game effect frame: a single 256x256 frame of vine/rope rustle around the Journey gate's blocking ropes
effect_journey_blocked_rustle.details: PER-FRAME GENERATION: generate ONE 256x256 frame per imagegen call. Save each frame as .agent/home-field-workspace/raw/journey_blocked_rustle.frame_NN.source.png (NN = 00..07). Each frame shows vines and ropes shifting slightly in a gentle breeze. The produce script composes them into a 2048x256 horizontal strip.
effect_journey_blocked_rustle.constraints: Loops cleanly. Motion is small and ambient. Per-frame raw filename: journey_blocked_rustle.frame_NN.source.png.

effect_tap_ripple.subject: transparent-background 2D game effect frame: a single 128x128 frame of a tap-to-move ripple at the player's tap point
effect_tap_ripple.details: PER-FRAME GENERATION: generate ONE 128x128 frame per imagegen call. Save each frame as .agent/home-field-workspace/raw/tap_ripple.frame_NN.source.png (NN = 00..03). Frame 0: small bright amber dot. Frame 1: expanding bright ring with the dot fading. Frame 2: larger softer ring. Frame 3: barely visible faded ring. The produce script composes them into a 512x128 horizontal strip. This is a one-shot animation (no loop).
effect_tap_ripple.constraints: Center-anchored. Reads instantly as 'tap acknowledged'. Per-frame raw filename: tap_ripple.frame_NN.source.png.

character_placeholder_silhouette.subject: transparent-background chibi placeholder — generic mushroom-elf silhouette for an 8 columns x 4 rows of 64x64 spritesheet (placeholder, not a specific character)
character_placeholder_silhouette.details:
PLACEHOLDER-ONLY LEGACY PER-FRAME GENERATION: this generic placeholder is generated as individual 64x64 frames, NOT as a single composed sheet. The produce script composes them. Generate these frames (save each at the listed path):
  - .agent/home-field-workspace/raw/_placeholder_chibi.frame_idle_down_0.source.png    (row 0 col 0)
  - .agent/home-field-workspace/raw/_placeholder_chibi.frame_idle_down_1.source.png    (row 0 col 1)
  - .agent/home-field-workspace/raw/_placeholder_chibi.frame_walk_down.source.png      (row 0 cols 2-7 will be replicated)
  - .agent/home-field-workspace/raw/_placeholder_chibi.frame_idle_up_0.source.png      (row 1 col 0)
  - .agent/home-field-workspace/raw/_placeholder_chibi.frame_idle_up_1.source.png      (row 1 col 1)
  - .agent/home-field-workspace/raw/_placeholder_chibi.frame_walk_up.source.png        (row 1 cols 2-7 replicated)
  - .agent/home-field-workspace/raw/_placeholder_chibi.frame_idle_left_0.source.png    (row 2 col 0)
  - .agent/home-field-workspace/raw/_placeholder_chibi.frame_idle_left_1.source.png    (row 2 col 1)
  - .agent/home-field-workspace/raw/_placeholder_chibi.frame_walk_left.source.png      (row 2 cols 2-7 replicated)
  - .agent/home-field-workspace/raw/_placeholder_chibi.frame_idle_right_0.source.png   (row 3 col 0)
  - .agent/home-field-workspace/raw/_placeholder_chibi.frame_idle_right_1.source.png   (row 3 col 1)
  - .agent/home-field-workspace/raw/_placeholder_chibi.frame_walk_right.source.png     (row 3 cols 2-7 replicated)
Generic mushroom-elf silhouette with visible elf ears in every direction. Mushroom cap hat (neutral colors). Cute-goth chibi proportions: oversized head, tiny body, bold silhouette, simple dark storybook outline. The two idle frames per direction are normal planted pose, then a little 1-3px bob/squish pose, not a crouch or deep squat. The single walk frame per direction shows a clear stride mid-step. The produce-home-field-assets.js character-mode composer reads these 12 raw files and writes the full 512x256 spritesheet, replicating each walk frame across columns 2-7 of its row.
character_placeholder_silhouette.size: 64x64 per individual frame (12 frames total for the placeholder)
character_placeholder_silhouette.constraints: Chibi feet near bottom of each frame. Elf ears visible in all 4 directions. Cute chibi proportions: large head, small body, ~3 heads tall. This compact 12-frame composer is placeholder-only legacy. Current Stage 1 Thalla proof candidates must follow the grouped 8x4 source-sheet and 32 split-frame contract from docs/home-field-chibi-candidate-contract.md.

character_thalla_chibi.subject: transparent-background Home Field chibi spritesheet candidate for Thalla, active-roster mushroom-elf field-sprite leader
character_thalla_chibi.details: CANDIDATE-ONLY STAGE 1 LOCAL-SOURCE PROOF: validate Thalla only from the queue-supplied complete 8x4 local state-sheet source. Do not run reference imagegen, built-in imagegen, paid API fallback, or text-only generation in this default run. First run npm run game:home-field:generation-queue -- --id=thalla-stage1-chibi-proof and follow the printed agent instructions. The active source path is .agent/home-field-workspace/supplied/thalla_tetro_cleaned_2026-06-30.states.source.png. Preflight with npm run game:home-field:preflight-chibi-proof -- --source=.agent/home-field-workspace/supplied/thalla_tetro_cleaned_2026-06-30.states.source.png, archive stale proof files with npm run game:home-field:archive-stale-chibi-proof -- thalla --source=.agent/home-field-workspace/supplied/thalla_tetro_cleaned_2026-06-30.states.source.png, then stage with npm run game:home-field:stage-chibi-local-source -- --source=.agent/home-field-workspace/supplied/thalla_tetro_cleaned_2026-06-30.states.source.png. Stop if any source, archive, or staging gate fails; do not reuse stale .agent files. The stage helper copies the supplied state sheet to .agent/home-field-workspace/raw/thalla_chibi.states.source.png, derives .agent/home-field-workspace/reference/thalla_chibi_turnaround.reference.png as a deterministic non-production reference proxy for evidence, and writes .agent/home-field-workspace/review/thalla-local-state-sheet-source.manifest.json. Skip reference imagegen for this local-source path. Treat docs/reference/home-field/chibi-thalla-previous-best-2026-06-26-state-sheet.png, docs/reference/home-field/chibi-thalla-liked-2026-06-23.png, and docs/reference/home-field/chibi-style-agent-log-reference.png as styleReferences for visual review only. They are not proof sources and must not be attached to imagegen in this run. Immediately verify the derived reference proxy with npm run game:home-field:verify-chibi-proof-files -- --reference and audit its palette with npm run game:home-field:palette-audit -- .agent/home-field-workspace/reference/thalla_chibi_turnaround.reference.png --out=.agent/home-field-workspace/review/thalla-reference-palette-audit.json --swatch=.agent/home-field-workspace/review/thalla-reference-palette-swatch.png --fail-on-bloat. Immediately verify the staged state sheet with npm run game:home-field:verify-chibi-proof-files -- --state-sheet and audit its palette with npm run game:home-field:palette-audit -- .agent/home-field-workspace/raw/thalla_chibi.states.source.png --out=.agent/home-field-workspace/review/thalla-state-sheet-palette-audit.json --swatch=.agent/home-field-workspace/review/thalla-state-sheet-palette-swatch.png --fail-on-bloat. The grouped state sheet must contain the idle bob and walk poses. Row order must be down, up, left, right. Columns 0-1 are idle frames: col 0 normal planted pose, col 1 little 1-3px bob/squish that loops back to normal while staying upright; do not make a crouch, seated pose, or deep squat. Columns 2-7 are the walk lane: aim for 4 meaningful walk poses distributed across 6 slots, with optional subtle holds/in-betweens rather than six important poses. Then split with npm run game:home-field:split-chibi-state-sheet -- --chroma-key=#ff00ff --resize.
